scope: typed input, result and mathematical aggregation definitions
entities.statement: The input is a record containing events, start, end, width and fill. Each event contains a Unicode-scalar string group, mathematical integer time and nullable mathematical integer value. The result is a list of records containing group, start, count and nullable integer value. Define G as the scalar-codepoint lexicographically sorted distinct group names occurring anywhere in events. Define B as the increasing sequence start+k*width for natural k with start+k*width<end. For g in G and b in B, define M(g,b) as the multiset of event occurrences with group=g, non-null value and b<=time<min(b+width,end), n(g,b) as its cardinality, and s(g,b) as the sum of its values.
